title: CRITICAL: PlaceObject3 HasFilterList encoded at wrong flags2 bit (0x10) — ALL 9 filters dropped by Ruffle
description:
FIXED (agent-1238). Root cause confirmed against ruffle/swf/src/types.rs PlaceFlag (HAS_FILTER_LIST=1<<8, HAS_IMAGE=1<<12). PlaceObject3 flags are a LE u16 (flags1 low byte, flags2 high byte), so flags2 bit N = combined bit 8+N: HasFilterList = flags2 bit 0 = 0x01; flags2 bit 4 = 0x10 = HAS_IMAGE.

CHANGES (packages/swf/src/filters.ts):
 - encodePlaceObject3WithFilters: flags2 HasFilterList 1<<4 (0x10) -> 1<<0 (0x01). Fixed comment block.
 - encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode: SAME bug found here too — flags2 |= 0x10 -> 0x01. Fixed comment.
 - Verified HasBlendMode (0x02) and HasCacheAsBitmap (0x04) and the cacheAsBitmap-only encoder (0x04) were already CORRECT; only HasFilterList was misnumbered, in BOTH filter-emitting encoders.

TESTS (all updated from the masking 0x10 assertion to 0x01, + assert HasImage 0x10 is CLEAR):
 filters.test.ts (5 spots) + NEW Ruffle-faithful u16 decode test (HAS_FILTER_LIST=1<<8 set, HAS_IMAGE=1<<12 clear); convolution-filter.test.ts; displacement-filter.test.ts; blendmode.test.ts (2 spots); blur-tween.test.ts (decoder gate flags2&0x10 -> &0x01, so the blur-tween test is now a real round-trip).

VERIFICATION:
 - swf @flash/swf: 115 files / 1441 tests PASS (incl. corrected filter + blur-tween + blendmode + new decode test).
 - swf crate decode proof (tools/swf-dump, swf 0.2.2 = Ruffle runtime) on REAL compileDocument() output: ALL 8 SWF filter types (DropShadow/Blur/Glow/Bevel/GradientGlow/Convolution/ColorMatrix/GradientBevel, IDs 0-7) now decode as PlaceObject3.filters=Some(...). Before the fix the crate read filters=None (HAS_IMAGE set) and dropped them all.
 - golden-parity: exit 0 (all hard dims PASS; only documented KNOWN-GAPs). No filters in golden so it is a clean regression check.
 - core: 3 pre-existing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla failures only (task 1207); no new failures.

SEPARATE FINDING (NOT this bug, out of scope): DisplacementMapFilter is encoded with FilterID=8, but the SWF FILTERLIST only defines IDs 0-7 (the swf crate Filter enum has no DisplacementMap — it is AS3-runtime-only). The crate rejects ID 8 as 'Invalid filter type'. This was masked before (crate never parsed the list). Documented in docs/08; warrants a follow-up task to stop emitting it into PlaceObject3.

Docs: docs/08-filters-blend-modes.md gains the PlaceObject3 LE-u16 PlaceFlag bit table + the DisplacementMap note.
